description: Header file defining structures, function prototypes, and licensing information for WLD sensing module, including CSI client management and counters.

methods.name: wld_sensing_init
methods.description: Initializes WLD sensing with a given radio context.

methods.name: wld_sensing_cleanup
methods.description: Cleans up WLD sensing resources for a given radio context.

methods.name: wld_sensing_delCsiClientEntry
methods.description: Deletes a CSI client entry based on MAC address.

methods.name: wld_sensing_findClientByMac
methods.description: Finds a CSI client by MAC address.
